origin: Numerical analysis of the tyre recording supplied by the project owner. Original online source and reuse terms were not supplied.
representation: Partial frequency/strength trajectories, initial oscillator phases and residual spectral magnitudes, normalized without the recording's overall level envelope.
rendering: Continuous oscillators and fresh seeded noise, driven by live contact, slip and history. No original PCM, residual waveform phases or recorded audio clips are played or packaged.
authorization: Owner approved the sound and requested a versioned audio release, then requested removal of source/comparison recordings before promotion.
scope: Provenance and technical composition only; this record makes no determination about the original recording's licence or fair use.
